controller.description: The route controller implementation: SupervisingRouteController or DefaultRouteController

startingRoutes.description: Whether routes are still starting (supervising controller only)

unhealthyRoutes.description: Whether any route is unhealthy (supervising controller only)

startedRoutes.description: Number of started routes (supervising controller only)

restartingRoutes.description: Number of restarting routes (supervising controller only)

exhaustedRoutes.description: Number of exhausted routes (supervising controller only)

initialDelay.description: Initial delay in milliseconds before restarting (supervising controller only)

backoffDelay.description: Backoff delay in milliseconds (supervising controller only)

backoffMaxDelay.description: Maximum backoff delay in milliseconds (supervising controller only)

backoffMaxElapsedTime.description: Maximum elapsed time in milliseconds before giving up (supervising controller only)

backoffMaxAttempts.description: Maximum number of restart attempts (supervising controller only)

threadPoolSize.description: The size of the restart thread pool (supervising controller only)

unhealthyOnRestarting.description: Whether a restarting route is considered unhealthy (supervising controller only)

unhealthyOnExhausted.description: Whether an exhausted route is considered unhealthy (supervising controller only)

attempts.description: Number of restart attempts (supervising controller only)

lastAttempt.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the last restart attempt (supervising controller only)

nextAttempt.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the next restart attempt (supervising controller only)

elapsed.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds of the current restart attempt (supervising controller only)

error.description: The restart error message (only present when the route is failing)

stackTrace.description: The restart error stack trace, one entry per line (only present when the route is failing and stack traces are requested)
